name: Public-label detector expansion v1
scope: OpenCows development training; MultiCam user-selected demonstration and previously used Toros diagnostic. Not independent farm or PYNQ performance.
checkpoint_selection: Use fixed final epoch last.pt for every seed; retain best.pt as additional archive only, no seed selection. All3 freeze before any new source or Toros model inference.
comparison: Retrain from same official checkpoint, not resume five-epoch weights. Longer schedule and explicitly fixed AdamW; report all seeds as development, not a pure epoch-only causal ablation.
input_restrictions: Only existing public training body-box labels and development validation enter training. No raw source video, no source pseudo-labels, no Toros training, no OpenCows dev_test forward.

source_replay.warmup: Decode from source0 and infer at frames divisible by5, preserving original tracking history. Save only requested source interval.

known_diagnostic: Reuse Toros full479frames30fps, ROIy0.1..0.95/gatex0.4/0.6, same threshold/ByteTrack/3samples/2second gap and 2second event matching. Already used diagnostic, not untouched evaluation.
browser_rule: Default seed26 fixed before results. Keep all seeds available; retain official and five-epoch views.
required_gates: input hashes and cleaned label bounds
all3checkpoint freeze before new video inference
actual source frame IDs and traces
independent count arithmetic and full media decode
